title: Consumer
description: The agent, SQL generator or knowledge base that proves a layer (D-019). semantic/<layer-id>/consumer.yaml.

corpus.description: Where the equivalence corpus is: a folder relative to the layer folder, or a pin for a corpus kept outside the repository and read from a path given at run time.

threshold.description: The share of corpus items that must pass (D-021); 0.9 when absent.

interface.description: The compile(request, layer) -> sql entry point: <path>:<function>, path relative to the model root.

extensions.description: A free map for adopters; never read by the core.

pin.description: The exact version read; the format depends on the source kind.
